intended_object: The basepoint of the covering space X̃/H associated with a subgroup H ≤ π₁(X, x₀): the image in the orbit quotient X̃/H of the class of the constant path at x₀. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: `SubgroupQuotient x₀ H` is defined in the same file as `MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H (UniversalCover x₀)`, the orbit quotient of the universal cover by `H`. `UniversalCover x₀` is a structure whose fields are an endpoint `proj : X` and a homotopy class of paths from `x₀` to `proj`. So `mk x₀ (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x₀)` is the point of the universal cover given by the constant path at `x₀`, the standard basepoint x̃₀. `Quotient.mk''` sends it to its H-orbit class. That class is the standard distinguished point of X̃/H used in the classification of coverings, and it lies over `x₀`. The body matches the docstring. It works for an arbitrary topological space and an arbitrary subgroup, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has no general counterpart, because the space it lives in is specific to this library.
